title: qxmd272: Questions fit the phone screen, cleaner solutions, round logo
body: Long questions, options and solutions now fit the phone screen; wide formulas scroll inside their own box. Fixed broken math such as $\Rightarrow$ showing as code, a wrong-looking answer label (A. 19 is now A. sqrt 19), the hard-to-read exam/date chip in dark mode and the stray lines in solutions. The chapter practice view on phones now uses the same compact toolbar, palette sheet and footer as the main practice view. The centre logo on the login page is round with a soft glow.
